canonicalIngredients.name: tomatoes
observations: 6 medium fresh (~6 cups) + 1/2 cup tomato sauce (s0)
3 medium fresh or 1 x 14 oz can diced (s3)

canonicalIngredients.name: feta
observations: 1/4-1/2 cup feta or goat cheese, optional (s3)

causalSequence: saute onion, capsicum in olive oil until soft, 5-8 min
add garlic, spices (tomato paste if using); bloom 30-60 sec
add tomatoes with juices; simmer until thick, 10-15 min
press wells in sauce; crack an egg into each
cover; cook on low until whites set, yolks still runny, 5-10 min
scatter herbs, feta if using; serve straight from the pan
techniqueFacts: all 4 sources poach eggs in wells pressed into the simmered sauce
3 sources cover the pan so whites set while yolks stay runny; 1 source finishes in a 190 C oven instead
sauce must thicken before eggs go in; 2 sources call for extra uncovered simmering to reduce
spices are bloomed with the aromatics before tomatoes go in (all 4 sources)
sauce can be made up to 4 days ahead and reheated before adding eggs (3 sources)
heat comes from optional cayenne/chilli flakes/chilli powder; all sources mark heat additions optional
canned tomatoes are the standard base; fresh swap is ~1.5-2 lb (6-8 medium) per 28 oz can (2 sources)
dish is served straight from the skillet; bread is a serving suggestion, not part of the cook (all sources)
